description: A family split into @font-face subsets by unicode-range, as @fontsource-variable/geist ships Geist (cyrillic, latin-ext, latin faces in that order, the cyrillic face without digits): text inputs at the default size, size=1 and size=2 sized from the primary font (the first face, latest defined first, whose range includes U+0020: the latin face), and Latin, Latin Extended, Cyrillic and mixed text at weights 400 and 600, each character from the latest-defined face whose range includes it (U+2020 is in the latin-ext and latin ranges). The input's value and a paragraph change at run time
